# Bharat Quantum Prospera

> CA-led advisory firm for founders, enterprises and investors building beyond borders. Operating under DRSPV & Associates Chartered Accountants. Founded by CA Durgesh Chavda. Offices in Ahmedabad, Mumbai, Bengaluru, Rajkot and Dubai.

Bharat Quantum Prospera (BQP) provides Chartered Accountant-led advisory across capital advisory, fundraising, M&A, SME IPO advisory, ESOP design and 409A valuation, GIFT City IFSC setup, US incorporation for Indian founders, cross-border taxation, fund structuring, corporate legal and FEMA compliance, and international expansion. We work with startups from seed to Series C, mid-market enterprises preparing for SME IPO or M&A, family offices, and investors setting up AIFs.

Live site: https://bharatquantumprospera.com
Founder: CA Durgesh Chavda (ICAI registered practising Chartered Accountant)
Contact: durgesh@bqpartners.in · +91 78018 87130 · WhatsApp: https://wa.me/917801887130

## Core services

- [Capital Advisory](https://bharatquantumprospera.com/capital-advisory.html): CFO-level capital planning, board reporting, fund-raise readiness
- [Fund Raising](https://bharatquantumprospera.com/fund-raising.html): Seed to Series C, term-sheet negotiation, cap-table structuring
- [Fund Structuring](https://bharatquantumprospera.com/fund-structuring.html): SEBI AIF Category I/II/III setup, GIFT City AIF, PMS
- [M&A and Transactions](https://bharatquantumprospera.com/ma-transactions.html): Buy-side, sell-side, vendor due-diligence, purchase-price allocation
- [SME IPO Advisory](https://bharatquantumprospera.com/sme-ipo.html): BSE SME and NSE Emerge IPO end-to-end (pre-issue readiness, DRHP, listing, post-listing compliance)
- [ESOP and Compensation](https://bharatquantumprospera.com/esop-compensation.html): ESOP scheme design, 409A / Rule 11UA valuation, ESOP tax planning
- [GIFT City IFSC](https://bharatquantumprospera.com/gift-city.html): IFSCA registration, AIF at GIFT City, banking unit, family office structuring
- [Global Taxation](https://bharatquantumprospera.com/global-taxation.html): DTAA advisory, transfer pricing, international tax structuring, Form 3CEB
- [US Incorporation](https://bharatquantumprospera.com/us-incorporation.html): Delaware C-Corp and LLC for Indian founders, EIN, US bank account, ongoing US-India compliance
- [Corporate Legal](https://bharatquantumprospera.com/corporate-legal.html): Companies Act filings, FEMA and ODI compliance, corporate secretarial
- [International Expansion](https://bharatquantumprospera.com/international-expansion.html): UAE, UK, Singapore, US market entry structuring

## Who we serve

- Indian startups from pre-seed to Series C
- Founders going India-to-US (Delaware C-Corp flip, EIN, US bank)
- Founders and firms setting up at GIFT City IFSC (AIF, banking unit, family office)
- Mid-market Indian enterprises preparing for SME IPO on BSE SME or NSE Emerge
- Mid-market companies executing M&A (buy-side, sell-side, VDD)
- Family offices and HNIs planning cross-border tax structures
- Investors setting up SEBI AIF (Cat I / II / III)

## What sets us apart

- CA-led practice: engagements led by a practising CA, not a marketing lead
- Cross-border focus: India to US, UK, UAE, Singapore, GIFT City IFSC
- Direct-access model: founder answers WhatsApp and email personally
- Free 20-minute call: no cost, no commitment, to establish fit
- Operating under DRSPV & Associates Chartered Accountants (ICAI registered)
